messages:
June (People Ops): Heads-up: annual Recognition Week is coming (July 12-16). We need to lock nomination windows, manager calibration meeting, and payout timelines.

Marco (Engineering Manager): What's the proposed nomination window?

June (People Ops): Proposal: nominations open Mon July 5 09:00 PT and run for 5 business days. Manager review closes Wed July 14 noon PT. Final sign-off by People Ops & Payroll by July 16 for July 21 payout.

Aisha (HRBP): Do we want a separate rubric for impact vs. culture awards? Last year managers conflated them.

June (People Ops): Good call. We'll surface two categories on the form (Impact, Culture) with brief prompts. Max 150 words and checkbox for "team consent" when award involves customer data.

Marco (Engineering Manager): Can managers nominate their direct reports? And what about cross-team nominations?

June (People Ops): Managers can nominate anyone. If cross-team, notify the nominee's manager automatically in the workflow.

Ben (Payroll): To meet July 21 payout we need final CSV by EOD July 16 16:00 PT. Include employee ID, amount, award_reason, nominator, manager_approval_ts. Also flag amounts over $500.

olivia-bot: Draft form created: https://forms.gle/recognition-week-draft (will be locked after review).

Aisha (HRBP): We should schedule a 30-min calibration session for people managers to review guidelines and edge cases. Suggested Wed July 7 10:00 PT.

June (People Ops): I can host that. I'll prepare 4 sample nominations to walk through. Agenda: eligibility, rubric walkthrough, escalation paths for conflicts, payroll timeline.

Marco (Engineering Manager): Will we have a blackout period for new hires? Some teams have interns starting mid-July.

June (People Ops): Eligibility: employed >=30 days by nomination open date. Interns who started July 1 would be ineligible. We'll include that in comms FAQ.

Ben (Payroll): Also note: consolidated awards per person count toward tax thresholds. If someone receives many small awards, payroll needs aggregate totals by calendar year.

Aisha (HRBP): I'll draft the FAQ language about eligibility and privacy (nominator anonymity options).

June (People Ops): Next steps: 1) Aisha to draft FAQ by Fri. 2) June will finalize form and comms kit Mon. 3) Ben to confirm CSV schema and payment SLA. 4) Marco to share calibration invite with managers.

Marco (Engineering Manager): Got it. I'll ping managers and add a calendar invite for July 7.

June (People Ops): Thanks team. Aim: seamless Recognition Week with clear timelines. Ping me for edge cases or if you want me to run the calibration with your org subset. :sparkles:
